{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Cuisine of India]]

'''Khichdi''' is a popular dish in the Indian state of Gujarat, where many families prefer it as a dinner. There also exist many variations of it across India. 

== Ingredients ==
* 1 teacup [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 1 teacup [[Cookbook:Dal|dal]] (e.g. [[Cookbook:Mung Bean|moong]] dhal, [[Cookbook:Pigeon Pea|arhar]] dal or [[Cookbook:Lentil|masoor dal]] or combination thereof)
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric powder]]

==Procedure==
# Wash rice and lentils and soak them for 10–15 minutes in water.
# Add salt and turmeric powder.
# [[Cookbook:Pressure Cooking|Pressure cook]] with 3–4 cups of water.
# After the first whistle, reduce the heat and cook for 4–5 more minutes.
# Allow to cool. Serve with [[Cookbook:Ghee|ghee]] or [[Cookbook:Buttermilk|buttermilk]].
